Replica identifiers and tenant/workspace identifiers are unique.
Tenant isolation is mandatory and cannot be weakened by replication.
No replica identifier, catalog entry, model output, memory, tool output, or workflow declaration grants authority.

Replication is parameterized; credentials, customer data, and provider secrets are never fixture data.

certification_state.note: Canonical ecosystem sequence: P0 forensic baseline/reconciliation; P1 contracts; P2 identity/tenancy; P3 events; P4 tracing/evidence; P5 registries; P6 routing; P7 adapters; P8 budgets; P9 MCP/A2A; P10 end-to-end production certification. P0 and P1 are certified against reviewed repository/reference evidence. P2 is the only next eligible phase. Historical taxonomy, delegation, runtime, evaluation, control-plane, workforce and replication suites are component gates, not evidence that similarly numbered canonical phases are complete. External production readiness remains unverified. The manifest phase field remains a contract-surface marker for replication/v1 validation, not a completion status.
